_meta.purpose: Job boards, aggregators and communities, tiered by signal-to-noise for Dev's three lanes.
_meta.provenance: Hand-authored 2026-09-08. The automated research pass for this file did not complete (session limit). Every entry below is a board that is well established and long-running, but the searchUrlTemplate values have NOT each been individually load-tested — treat a template that 404s as a bug to fix here, not as a reason to distrust the file.
_meta.rule: Login-gated boards are for MANUAL use only. Never point an automated scraper at them — see HANDOFF.md guardrails.
_meta.placeholders: {QUERY} = url-encoded search terms, {LOCATION} = url-encoded city or 'remote'.

tier1_ai_specialist.rationale: Where AI / agent / FDE roles surface first. Lowest volume, highest relevance to Dev's differentiator. Check these before anything else.

boards.name: YC Work at a Startup
boards.note: Free login. The single best source of AI-agent roles at funded early startups, many remote-friendly. Set your profile to 'open to remote' and let founders find you.

boards.name: Wellfound (AngelList Talent)
boards.note: Startup roles with salary bands shown up front. Good remote-India filtering.

boards.name: AI Jobs (ai-jobs.net)
boards.note: Aggregates AI/ML roles globally; filter to India or remote. Skews research-heavy, so read past the ML-scientist listings for engineering roles.

boards.name: Hacker News 'Who is Hiring'
boards.note: Monthly thread, 1st of each month. Search it for 'REMOTE' + 'India'. Direct-to-engineer, no recruiter layer — unusually high response rate for a well-written reply.

tier2_high_signal_india.rationale: Curated Indian tech boards. Far less noise than Naukri, and recruiters on these actually read profiles.

boards.name: Instahyre
boards.note: Highest signal of the Indian boards for product companies. Complete the profile fully — matching is algorithmic and a thin profile gets buried.

boards.name: Cutshort
boards.note: Strong for startup product roles. Skill-tag driven — tag Flutter, Kotlin, React, Node and AI to get matched.

boards.name: Hirist
boards.note: Tech-only arm of the iimjobs group. Decent mid-level product volume.

boards.name: Wellfound India
boards.note: India-filtered view of Wellfound.

tier3_volume_generalist.rationale: High volume, high noise. Use with tight filters and expect recruiter spam. Worth it purely for coverage.

boards.name: LinkedIn Jobs
boards.note: The f_TPR=r86400 parameter filters to the last 24h — always use it. NEVER point an automated scraper at LinkedIn; it violates their ToS and risks the account. Guest search in a browser only.

boards.name: Naukri
boards.note: Largest Indian volume. Set the resume to 'visible to recruiters' and refresh it weekly — freshness materially drives recruiter search ranking.

boards.name: Indeed India
boards.note: fromage=1 limits to the last day. Heavy duplication with company boards.

boards.name: Foundit (ex-Monster India)
boards.note: Lower quality than Naukri but occasionally carries roles the others miss.

tier4_remote_global.rationale: Remote roles that may accept an India-based engineer. Always verify India eligibility on the JD itself — many say 'remote' and mean 'remote within the US'.

boards.name: RemoteOK
boards.note: Has a public JSON feed at https://remoteok.com/api — genuinely scrapeable. Check the 'region' field for India eligibility.

boards.name: We Work Remotely
boards.note: Long-running and reputable. Many roles are US/EU-only — read the fine print before spending time.

boards.name: Remotive
boards.note: Public API at https://remotive.com/api/remote-jobs. Good tagging.

boards.name: Himalayas
boards.note: Explicit per-country hiring filters, which makes India eligibility unusually easy to confirm.

tier5_startup_direct.rationale: Bypass the recruiter layer entirely. VC portfolio boards list roles at funded companies, often before they hit the aggregators.

boards.name: Peak XV (ex-Sequoia India) portfolio jobs
boards.note: India's largest VC portfolio board. Strong overlap with the Tier-A companies already in companies.json.

boards.name: Accel India portfolio jobs
boards.note: Filter to India-based portfolio companies.

boards.name: Blume Ventures jobs
boards.note: Early-stage Indian startups — smaller teams, broader scope, faster hiring loops.

boards.name: Elevation Capital jobs
boards.note: Consumer and fintech heavy.

tier6_salary_intel.rationale: NOT job boards. Use these only to establish a comp band before a recruiter call, and to sanity-check an offer.

boards.name: Levels.fyi India
boards.note: Best data for product companies and GCCs. Thin for early startups.

boards.name: AmbitionBox
boards.note: Broadest Indian coverage including services companies. Self-reported, so read the median not the max.

boards.name: 6figr
boards.note: Good for India tech comp percentiles by years of experience.

boards.name: Glassdoor India
boards.note: Use for interview-process reports as much as for salary.
